description: Default capability — the about page is read-only and uses only `get_snapshot` (its own data) and `cmd_log` (forwards JS console to stderr). Both are custom commands inherited via `core:default`; no built-in core/window/webview commands are invoked from JS in the simplified model. The Rust dispatch path for broker commands (Pause/Play/Manual/Fullscreen/DevTools/Autostart{Install,Uninstall}/Shutdown) does not need capabilities — it goes through Tauri's Rust API, not invoke().
